stem: External partners need to exchange files over SFTP with an S3-backed destination, while a separate one-time 200 TB migration from an on-premises HDFS cluster must finish before the cluster is decommissioned. Select TWO correct service matches. (Select TWO.)

choices.text: AWS Transfer Family for the partner SFTP exchange
AWS Storage Gateway for the partner SFTP exchange
AWS Transfer Family for the HDFS migration
AWS Storage Gateway for the HDFS migration
AWS DataSync for the one-time HDFS migration

rationale: AWS Transfer Family provides the managed SFTP endpoint the partners need, backed by S3. AWS DataSync fits a one-time bulk migration from an on-premises HDFS cluster, since it transfers data online with no appliance to run and finishes once the migration completes. Storage Gateway is for keeping an on-premises application running against a local cache indefinitely, not for an SFTP endpoint or a migration that finishes and disconnects. Transfer Family does not perform bulk cluster migrations; its endpoints exist for partner file protocols, not a one-time HDFS copy.
